# 12-Week General Strength Programme
## Client: 42M, Post-L4-L5 Herniation, Desk Worker

---

## PROGRAMME OVERVIEW

This 12-week programme prioritises spinal stability and general strength while respecting the constraint of no heavy spinal loading or loaded spinal flexion. The approach emphasises:

- **Anti-rotation and anti-extension core work** (safer than flexion-based training)
- **Posterior chain activation** (glutes, hamstrings, upper back)
- **Neutral spine strength** in compound movements
- **Postural correction** for desk worker positioning
- **Progressive loading** through variation and density rather than absolute weight
- **Movement quality** over intensity

The client trains **3 days per week** with 48 hours between sessions. Each session lasts approximately 50–60 minutes.

---

## PHASE STRUCTURE

| Phase | Weeks | Focus | RPE Range |
|-------|-------|-------|-----------|
| **Phase 1: Foundation & Stability** | 1–4 | Movement quality, core stability, postural awareness | 5–6/10 |
| **Phase 2: Strength Building** | 5–8 | Progressive loading, compound patterns, density | 6–7/10 |
| **Phase 3: Consolidation & Resilience** | 9–12 | Strength maintenance, work capacity, movement variability | 6–7/10 |

---

## PHASE 1: FOUNDATION & STABILITY (WEEKS 1–4)

### Goals
- Establish movement patterns with perfect form
- Activate and strengthen core stabilisers
- Correct postural imbalances from desk work
- Build confidence in loaded movement
- Establish training consistency

### Session Structure (3x per week: Mon/Wed/Fri)

**Warm-up (8–10 minutes)**
- 3 minutes easy rowing or walking
- Cat-cow stretches: 10 reps
- Glute bridges: 15 reps
- Dead bugs: 12 reps each side
- Scapular wall slides: 12 reps
- Bodyweight squats: 12 reps

---

### WEEK 1

**Session A (Monday)**

| Exercise | Sets | Reps | Notes |
|----------|------|------|-------|
| Goblet squat | 3 | 10 | 8kg kettlebell, pause 2 sec at bottom |
| Prone Y-T-W raises | 3 | 8 each | Bodyweight, slow tempo |
| Pallof press (half-kneeling) | 3 | 10 each side | Light band, focus on anti-rotation |
| Glute bridge | 3 | 12 | Bodyweight, 2-sec hold at top |
| Bird dog | 3 | 10 each side | Slow, controlled |
| Quadruped shoulder taps | 2 | 12 each side | Bodyweight |

**Session B (Wednesday)**

| Exercise | Sets | Reps | Notes |
|----------|------|------|-------|
| Trap bar deadlift (light) | 3 | 8 | 20kg total, focus on hip hinge |
| Inverted row (assisted if needed) | 3 | 8 | Feet elevated on bench |
| Half-kneeling Pallof chop | 3 | 10 each side | Light band |
| Single-leg glute bridge | 3 | 8 each | Bodyweight |
| Plank (modified) | 3 | 20–30 sec | Knees down if needed |
| Thoracic rotation (quadruped) | 2 | 10 each side | Bodyweight |

**Session C (Friday)**

| Exercise | Sets | Reps | Notes |
|----------|------|------|-------|
| Dumbbell bench press | 3 | 10 | 6kg dumbbells, neutral grip |
| Reverse pec deck | 3 | 12 | Light weight, focus on scapular retraction |
| Suitcase carry | 3 | 30m each side | 8kg kettlebell |
| Copenhagen adductor squeeze | 3 | 12 | Bodyweight, slow |
| Prone cobra | 2 | 20 sec | Bodyweight, gentle |
| Banded pull-apart | 2 | 15 | Light band |

---

### WEEK 2

Repeat Week 1 structure. **Progression method:** Add 1–2 reps to each exercise or reduce rest periods by 10 seconds.

---

### WEEK 3

**Session A (Monday)**

| Exercise | Sets | Reps | Notes |
|----------|------|------|-------|
| Goblet squat | 4 | 12 | 10kg kettlebell |
| Prone Y-T-W raises | 3 | 10 each | Bodyweight |
| Pallof press (half-kneeling) | 3 | 12 each side | Light band |
| Single-leg glute bridge | 3 | 10 each | Bodyweight |
| Bird dog | 3 | 12 each side | Slow tempo |
| Quadruped shoulder taps | 3 | 15 each side | Bodyweight |

**Session B (Wednesday)**

| Exercise | Sets | Reps | Notes |
|----------|------|------|-------|
| Trap bar deadlift | 4 | 10 | 30kg total |
| Inverted row | 4 | 10 | Feet elevated |
| Half-kneeling Pallof chop | 3 | 12 each side | Light band |
| Single-leg glute bridge | 3 | 10 each | Bodyweight |
| Plank | 3 | 30–40 sec | Knees down or full |
| Thoracic rotation (quadruped) | 3 | 12 each side | Bodyweight |

**Session C (Friday)**

| Exercise | Sets | Reps | Notes |
|----------|------|------|-------|
| Dumbbell bench press | 4 | 12 | 8kg dumbbells |
| Reverse pec deck | 3 | 15 | Light weight |
| Suitcase carry | 3 | 40m each side | 10kg kettlebell |
| Copenhagen adductor squeeze | 3 | 15 | Bodyweight |
| Prone cobra | 3 | 25 sec | Bodyweight |
| Banded pull-apart | 3 | 18 | Light band |

---

### WEEK 4

**Session A (Monday)**

| Exercise | Sets | Reps | Notes |
|----------|------|------|-------|
| Goblet squat | 4 | 12 | 12kg kettlebell |
| Prone Y-T-W raises | 3 | 12 each | Bodyweight |
| Pallof press (standing) | 3 | 12 each side | Light band, increased range |
| Single-leg glute bridge | 4 | 12 each | Bodyweight |
| Bird dog | 3 | 15 each side | Bodyweight |
| Quadruped shoulder taps | 3 | 20 each side | Bodyweight |

**Session B (Wednesday)**

| Exercise | Sets | Reps | Notes |
|----------|------|------|-------|
| Trap bar deadlift | 4 | 12 | 40kg total |
| Inverted row | 4 | 12 | Feet elevated |
| Half-kneeling Pallof chop | 4 | 12 each side | Light band |
| Single-leg glute bridge | 4 | 12 each | Bodyweight |
| Plank | 3 | 40–50 sec | Full plank |
| Thoracic rotation (quadruped) | 3 | 15 each side | Bodyweight |

**Session C (Friday)**

| Exercise | Sets | Reps | Notes |
|----------|------|------|-------|
| Dumbbell bench press | 4 | 12 | 10kg dumbbells |
| Reverse pec deck | 4 | 15 | Light weight |
| Suitcase carry | 4 | 50m each side | 12kg kettlebell |
| Copenhagen adductor squeeze | 3 | 18 | Bodyweight |
| Prone cobra | 3 | 30 sec | Bodyweight |
| Banded pull-apart | 3 | 20 | Light band |

---

## PHASE 1 SUMMARY

By the end of Week 4, the client should demonstrate:
- Confident, controlled movement in all patterns
- Improved posture and awareness of neutral spine
- Ability to activate glutes and core on demand
- No pain or discomfort during or after sessions
- Readiness for progressive loading

---

## PHASE 2: STRENGTH BUILDING (WEEKS 5–8)

### Goals
- Increase absolute strength in primary patterns
- Build work capacity and training density
- Introduce tempo variation and pauses
- Maintain impeccable movement quality
- Develop resilience through progressive challenge

### Session Structure

Sessions remain **3x per week** but now incorporate:
- **Primary compound lift** (heavier, lower reps)
- **Secondary compound lift** (moderate weight, moderate reps)
- **Accessory work** (higher reps, stability focus)
- **Core/anti-movement work** (maintained throughout)

## PHASE 3: CONSOLIDATION & RESILIENCE (WEEKS 9–12)

### Goals
- Consolidate strength gains
- Introduce movement variability to build robustness
- Increase training density and work capacity
- Maintain spinal safety while challenging the system
- Prepare for long-term independent training

### Session Structure

Sessions remain **3x per week** with:
- **Varied primary lifts** (rotate between similar patterns)
- **Maintained secondary lifts**
- **Increased density** (more work in same time)
- **Movement variability** (different angles, tempos, implements)
